project.name: Customer Support Portal
project.problem: Support agents spend too long finding customer history.
project.goal: Reduce the time needed to understand a customer's previous interactions.
successMetrics: 90% of agents find a customer record within 30 seconds
constraints: Must use the existing identity provider

requirements.statement: The system shall allow an authenticated support agent to search customer records by email.
requirements.rationale: Agents need a fast way to locate the correct customer.

acceptance.given: An authenticated support agent is viewing the search page
acceptance.when: They submit a valid customer email
acceptance.then: The matching customer record is displayed

decisions.question: Which identity system should be used?

openQuestions.question: Should partial email matches be supported?
